a13.title: Slim Pave Huggies
a13.descriptionHtml:
One line of light down a slim rectangle. Gold tone huggies of about 18mm, shaped as a rectangle with softly rounded corners and set down the front with a single row of small round clear cubic zirconia, close with a hinged snap.

STYLING TIP: Stack them with the Brushed Gold Huggies.

Details

  • Size: Approximately 18mm tall and 10mm deep, about 2mm wide
  • Stones: One row of small round clear cubic zirconia down the front, in fine claws
  • Closure: Hinged snap
  • Sold as: One pair
  • Finish: Polished gold tone
  • Material: Stainless steel, as on the supplier's card

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
